name: crabarium
description: A pane that shows the main session and its subagents, with an animated pixel character for each agent

motion.title: Character motion
motion.description: full: the characters move. reduced: each character shows one still pose for its state. off: the characters do not change.

pack.title: Character pack
pack.description: The pack that draws the characters. /crabarium pack lists the packs and selects one. User packs go in <config dir>/crabarium/packs/<name>/pack.json.

avatarMode.title: Outfit selection
avatarMode.description: keywords: each agent gets an outfit from the words of its task and its type. off: only your rules and the pack defaults.

avatarRules.title: Outfit rules
avatarRules.description: Your rules, first match wins: pattern = target; pattern = target. A pattern is an agent type or a word of the task. A target is a role (explorer, reviewer, builder, tester, planner, researcher) or parts with weights: hat:judge*3 | hat:cap. Example: linus-reviewer = reviewer; migration = hat:cap
